title: Zesty Greek Doner Meat Tzatziki
description: A delicious, easy-to-make Greek dish featuring doner meat, tzatziki sauce, and crispy fried onions. Perfect for a lazy Sunday afternoon.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the grated onion and cook until crispy, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the doner meat to the skillet and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned and cooked through.
Transfer the cooked doner meat to a plate.
In a large bowl, combine the yogurt, cucumber, dill, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lemon juice to the bowl and mix well.
To assemble the dish, place a portion of the cooked doner meat on a plate, followed by a dollop of the tzatziki sauce and a sprinkle of crispy fried onions.
